decisions.evidence: Taken together, the six neighbor comparisons are consistently weighted toward option (B). The three positive neighbors all align directly with mutagenic structural alerts, especially the increased alkyl chloride burden and the repeated acetal presence, with supporting charge and heteroatom signals. The three negative neighbors do contain some exposure-limiting features such as higher QED and larger size metrics, but they still retain the same core mutagenic structural pattern in the query, so they do not outweigh the mutagenic evidence. The overall local analog evidence therefore supports option (B): is mutagenic.
